data.title: Falling Bitcoin Prices Drag Down Products and Mining Revenue for Canaan (CAN)
data.description: On September 8, Canaan Inc. (NASDAQ:CAN) announced its second quarter FY26 results, which did not inspire confidence. The computing and energy infrastructure innovator posted total revenue of $31.9 million during the quarter. The topline figure went down compared to $100.2 million in Q2 FY25 and $62.7 million posted during the first quarter of 2026. Canaan […]
